title: Kanda 8: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 8.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 8.

verses.original: मा बिभेर्न मरिष्यसि जरदष्टिं कृणोमि त्वा । निरवोचमहं यक्ष्ममङ्गेभ्यो जरसा सह ॥
verses.transliteration: mā bibherna mariṣyasi jaradaṣṭiṁ kṛṇomi tvā | niravocamahaṁ yakṣmamaṅgebhyo jarasā saha ||
verses.translation: Fear not! Thou shalt not die; I make thee attain full ripened age! I have driven away consumption from thy limbs, bestowing healthy longevity!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Vedic healing prayer banishing terminal disease and instilling vibrant faith in life.
